Home›Rakuten Mobile Upgrade Program: Returns, Timing and Costs

REPLACEMENT PROGRAM GUIDE

The device upgrade program,
made simple.

Buy an eligible phone in 48 installments. Return it in months 25–47 and meet the inspection conditions to waive the remaining installments; if you do not return it, payments continue through month 48.

See how it works ↓Check Rakuten Mobile ↗ (Japanese)

Remember these 3 numbers

  1. 48Device installments
  2. 25–47Months when you may request a return
  3. Up to 24Remaining installments that may be waived

HOW IT WORKS

A conditional return program—not a guaranteed half-price purchase

This is a 48-installment device program. If you return the device in months 25–47 and it meets Rakuten Mobile’s inspection conditions, later installments are waived. A ¥3,300 handling fee and possible device-condition charges must also be considered. If you keep the device, payments continue through month 48; the program then ends automatically and no return is required.

PAYMENT TIMELINE

The process at a glance

  1. At purchase
    Choose an eligible device and 48 payments

    Join the program when purchasing. A Rakuten Card in the subscriber’s name is required.

  2. Months 1–24
    Pay the scheduled device amount

    Monthly amounts vary by model and campaign.

  3. Months 25–47
    Choose whether to return or keep the device

    Check the exact eligible date under Device Information in my Rakuten Mobile, then request a return or device change.

Return

Remaining payments may be waived

If the device passes inspection, later installments are waived. A ¥3,300 handling fee applies when you return it.

Keep

Pay through installment 48

If you do not return the device, payments continue through installment 48. At the end of month 48 the program ends automatically, and you do not need to return the phone.

SIMPLE EXAMPLE

Example with a ¥120,000 phone

A simplified equal-payment example. Actual amounts vary.

Device price¥120,000
÷
48 payments¥2,500
24 payments¥60,000
＋
Return fee¥3,300
＝
Example total¥63,300

Excludes damage fees and communication charges.

WHO IS IT FOR?

Who it may suit

○Good fit

  • You replace your phone about every two years
  • You want smaller monthly device payments
  • You can keep the device in good condition
  • You have a Rakuten Card

△Think carefully

  • You keep the same phone for three or four years
  • You want to keep the old device
  • Damage or water exposure is likely
  • You want to pay without a Rakuten Card

IMPORTANT

Checks before applying

01

Rakuten Card required

The card must be in the subscriber’s name.

02

Join at purchase

The program cannot be added later.

03

Return fee

A handling fee applies when returning the device.

04

Damage may cost extra

Damage can lead to an additional charge or rejected return.

05

Erase your data

Back up, unlock accounts, and factory-reset before return.

06

Check cancellation rules

Confirm the latest terms before applying.

Damage charges depend on the purchase date

For devices purchased at or after 9:00 a.m. on July 23, 2026, damage charges vary by model. Devices purchased by 8:59 a.m. that day remain under the previous flat ¥22,000 (tax-exempt) rule. Check the current model-specific amount and any warranty conditions. If a device is ineligible for acceptance, it is returned and the remaining balance may be billed in full.

STEPS

From purchase to return

  1. 1

    Choose an eligible device

    Check eligibility on the device page.

  2. 2

    Select the program

    Choose 48 payments with Rakuten Card.

  3. 3

    Continue the installment payments

    Payments begin in the month you receive the device.

  4. 4

    Apply in months 25–47

    Confirm the exact eligible date in my Rakuten Mobile, then request a return only or a device change.

  5. 5

    Back up and reset

    Remove locks and erase personal data.

  6. 6

    Return by the deadline

    Use the instructed method and wait for inspection.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can I return the phone in month 25?＋

You may request a return from month 25 through month 47. The exact eligible date varies by contract, so check Device Information in my Rakuten Mobile. A ¥3,300 handling fee applies.

What happens if I do not return the phone?＋

Payments continue through installment 48. When the 48-month term ends, the program closes automatically and you may keep the device without returning it.

Can I return the phone after cancelling the mobile line?＋

The line contract and the device installments/program are separate. Cancelling the line does not stop device payments. Check your contract conditions and request the return in my Rakuten Mobile.

How much is the damage charge?＋

For purchases at or after 9:00 a.m. on July 23, 2026, the amount varies by model. Purchases by 8:59 a.m. that day use the previous flat ¥22,000 (tax-exempt) rule. Check the latest model-specific amount and warranty conditions.

What if the device is not accepted?＋

An ineligible device is returned to you, and the entire remaining balance may be billed at once. Remove screen locks, linked accounts and device-finding features, and confirm all official return conditions.

Related guides

  • Android eligibility
  • Disadvantages and precautions

Confirm the latest official information

Eligible models, monthly amounts, damage charges and return conditions can change. The mobile line contract and device program are separate; line cancellation does not cancel the device installments. Check the official terms and your exact return date in my Rakuten Mobile.
